target_customer: Private equity funds, plus corporates, hedge funds and VCs that buy commercial due diligence
problem: Market due diligence from large consultancies costs $500K to $1M per deal, takes weeks and ends in static slides that cannot be audited.
business_model: Project based AI enabled consulting and platform fees
product_category: AI commercial due diligence and market research

founders.name: Frederik Hansen
prior_employers: Blackstone (Principal, about six years per launch post)

founders.name: Harshil Rastogi
previous_startups: Earlier startup as repeat founder (not named)

competitors.name: Bridgetown Research
competitors.what: AI agents combining voice and web data for diligence

competitors.name: AlphaSense/Tegus
competitors.what: Expert call transcript library and market intelligence

competitors.name: McKinsey, BCG, Bain
competitors.what: Traditional commercial due diligence at $500K to $1M per report

technical_complexity.rationale: AI voice interviewers, expert sourcing and claim to transcript traceability need solid LLM engineering but rely on available models.

defensibility.rationale: Founders have buyer and seller credentials and PE relationships, but the workflow is copyable by funded AI rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy or acquisition found as of March 2026; Tegus launched AI led calls in February 2026 per one article.

market_need_then: Founders say a large PE fund can spend over $30M a year on market diligence and the YC page claims a $10B market; these are company claims. Eight PE funds were already clients at launch per YC page.

identity.visual_style: Institutional B2B site with client logo walls
identity.voice_and_tone: Rigor of a premier advisory firm with the speed of a machine

branding.brand_signature: Every claim linked to a source transcript
branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage in TechCrunch and trade outlets in March 2026; no merch or community.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name with a math twist is memorable in PE circles; press came from the funding news, not from the brand.

outcome_analysis: DiligenceSquared raised a $5M seed in March 2026, about six months after the Fall 2025 batch, from Relentless and YC among others. Founders who bought and sold diligence at Blackstone and BCG gave credible access to private equity buyers, and the company reports clients with trillions in AUM. The risks are funded AI rivals and consultancies adopting AI themselves; outcome is still open.
notes: One aggregator names Damir Becirovic as lead; most outlets say Relentless. Headquarters listed as New York or San Francisco. Client AUM claim differs between YC page ($2.4T) and website ($4T+). Education not found. Rastogi's last name comes from press, YC page gives only Harshil. Competitor funding for Bridgetown seen in aggregator summaries, unverified. Price of about $50K per project is from press, not the company.
